title_en: Would you mind turning down the music?
goal_ko: Would you mind로 부탁하고, 괜찮다고 답하고, 더 정중하게 부탁하기

help.blank: Would you ___ turning down the music?

expressions.pattern: ^(?:excuse me )?(?:would you mind|do you mind) (?<x>[a-z]+ing(?: [a-z]+){0,8})(?: please)?$
expressions.accept_note: mind 뒤에는 -ing. ‘Would you mind close …’·‘Can you …?’는 뜻 전달(부분).

ok: Would you mind turning down the music?
excuse me do you mind closing the window
partial: Would you mind close the window
Would you mind to close the window?

expressions.accept_note: Would you mind …?에 ‘Yes’는 ‘싫어요’ 뜻이라 부분으로만 셈.

scene.en: Excuse me. Would you mind turning down your music?
Oh, sorry! I didn’t know it was loud.
I’d appreciate it if you could use headphones.
Of course. Would you mind watching my bag for a minute?
